title: Monitoring probe fails: widget-cli --health missing despite a fix sitting in the mirror
description_md:
The monitoring stack just started probing this host with `widget-cli --health`, and it's failing every time with `unknown option: --health`. Ops says the fix already shipped: version `2.0-1` of `widget-cli`, which adds the `--health` subcommand, is sitting right in this host's internal package mirror. But something is stopping the upgrade from actually landing, even though nothing looks broken about the mirror itself. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`) and get the newer version actually installed.

You're done when `widget-cli --health` reports `OK`.
